biomes.BiomeIce: cool northern lowlands and alpine snow

ElRuhn.name: Kingdom of El Ruhn
ElRuhn.scale_note: Reference geography guides neighboring regions; current playable island size is preserved. The map is not a literal survey of island dimensions.

ecology.climate_assumption: Easterly maritime moisture; a sheltered western dry basin, spring-fed southern desert fringe and wetter eastern and southern woodland. Stylized compressed regional geography, not a climate simulation.
ecology.northern_lowlands: cool scrub and woodland; snow restricted to high elevation
ecology.desert_transition: desert to semi-arid sand and grass mosaic with spring-fed oases, then plains
ecology.coast: Golden sand reaches the same shoreline coordinate as the ocean; wet sand blends directly into water. Low coastal benches; rockier highland coasts.

polish.cliff: deep winding canyon, layered walls, side ravines and remnant ledges
polish.terrain: adaptive shoreline, cliff and mountain mesh refinement
polish.clouds: 24 visible banks in three uneven groups; opacity .59; central view open

desert_canyon.type: deep diagonal sandstone canyon with stepped walls and six side ravines
desert_canyon.floor: dry seasonal wash; no arbitrary lake or river crossing
desert_canyon.future_use: broad remnant ledges for a possible nomad cliff settlement

content_refinement.direction: smooth sculpted stylized forms inspired by Fortnite art direction
content_refinement.scenic_shading: continuous height-derived world-space normals; projected painted-rock detail

DivineEmpireofGosain.identity: fortified religious island nation with mainland provinces
DivineEmpireofGosain.visuals: cathedral citadel, defensive curtain walls, gate towers, monasteries, banner standards

YozuanDesert.identity: two distinct groups: nomads and cultists
YozuanDesert.visuals: nomad caravan camps and oasis markets; separate remote dark sandstone sanctuaries

KelsinFederation.identity: resource-poor society specializing in magic technology
KelsinFederation.visuals: arcane manufactories, civic workshops, crystal-powered towers, conduit networks; no mines or resource export depots

RabaricRepublic.visuals: country-wide surveyed rectangular crop grid, market towns, farm villages, mills, granaries and connecting farm lanes

VylfodDominion.visuals: tidal creeks, reed beds, palms, stilt homes, raised boardwalks and fishing harbors

scope: Regional scenery with water-safe settlement footprints and connected roads; mainland gameplay is not implemented.
